newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Craig & Co to launch NZ Mid-cap index product.
newsitem.headline: Craig & Co to launch NZ Mid-cap index product.

text.p: Tauranga-based brokerage Craig & Co confirmed it is to launch a new product based on the New Zealand Stock Exchange's Mid-cap Index, Managing Director Neil Craig told Reuters on Thursday.
Craig & Co has applied for exchange listing for the product which will operate as a passive fund in a similar fashion to the Stock Exchange's TeNZ fund.
Craig said he expects the fund to be registered within a couple of weeks but said Security Commission regulations prevented him disclosing further details until after registration of the prospectus.
"It is a listed index fund that will track the new Stock Exchange Mid-cap index, a passive fund similar in structure to TeNZ. That's all I can say," Craig said.
Craig & Co has 12 offices around the country.
